extracted.name: Pink Panties
extracted.description: This pink panty recipe makes a summertime drink with pink lemonade, gin, ice cream, and strawberries, sure to help cool you down. Try it garnished with a dollop of whipped topping and a fanned strawberry.
ingredient_lines: 1 (12 fluid ounce) can frozen pink lemonade concentrate
instruction_lines: Combine frozen lemonade concentrate, gin, ice, ice cream, and strawberries in a blender. Process until smooth. Pour into glasses and serve.
